head: 0cf8d4b64c302091cdf67586879ef774e4f1e74f
observed: Validator halts on block1087 BAL write-set mismatch: local0 versus published3 accounts, session1967898965, one of four observed BAL sessions. All three executors report286 identical nonce-too-low canonical skips, at blocks1073,1084,1103. All three later detect committed canonical history changes and roll back from divergence block1083.
fixture_violation: SmallBudget directly registers a saved cluster job with daLagBudgetBlocks=8, then restores the original budget. The workloads release gate explicitly lists daLagBudgetBlocks as must-match because mixed values fork replicated accept/reject decisions. The fixture bypasses that gate while replaying an existing log.
evidence: retained executor, validator and sealer logs in chaos-diagnostics-chaos-retention/
classification: Invalid live change of replicated configuration is established. It can change decisions during historical log replay. The mismatch verdict is real and remains fatal. Fresh guard-from-genesis runtime validation is required to determine whether any further product failure remains.
scope: Retain the failed shard. Do not ignore a replica, reset divergence counters, weaken state checks or retry the same head. The preceding retention-overrun, validator overrun and prune-floor cases pass.
proposed_fix: Run the two DA-guard cases on a separate fresh chain inside the existing retention job, with the small guard fixed from genesis. Keep all cases and complete end-of-phase receipt, validator and exact persisted-state gates. Never change must-match settings on a running chain. No new shard or recovery deadline increase.
